秦婉看见锅台上的肉饼，一把就抻住了王野的耳朵：“来来，你给我看看，这是小肉饼？一张都有脸盆那么大了。”

“娘，娘，娘～，疼，疼。哪儿有脸盆那么大，明明比脸盆小一圈的。”

秦婉松开手，一掀锅盖，又要去抓王野的耳朵，这次王野早有准备，两步就跑到了门口：“你管这个叫粥？这就干饭多一点汤。你个败家玩意儿，一点都不会过日子。”

王野指着面柜：“娘，我昨天晚上去鸽子市了，又弄回来不少的大米和白面。就咱家这几口人够吃的，再说了，偶尔吃顿好的也没什么问题。”

秦婉赶紧去看面柜，一打开柜门，看着里面满满的两个面口袋。伸手进去摸了一下，又在柜里翻找起来。找了一会儿转头问王野：“咱家，面柜里的替代粮呢？”

王野昨晚放大米，白面的时候就收进空间了，但是秦婉既然问了就得给个答复：“我昨天就拿去鸽子市了，娘，那东西还是少吃的好，我听说替代粮吃多了会积食的。”

秦婉怎么会不知道，替代粮吃多了会积食呢，有严重的好几天都不能大便。自家大儿子把替代粮换成了细粮，怎么也不能怪罪呀，再说了，这也不是第一次弄回细粮了。

秦婉叹了口气，还是去盛饭了，做都做了，还能怎么办。现在的天气，也不能放着呀，不用两天就坏了。秦婉喊了一声，王铁柱和王江河就来端碗了。

王江河端着一大盘子的肉饼，边走边用力的闻着香味儿。后面传来秦婉的训斥声：“你要是敢把口水滴在饼上，今天的早饭你就不用吃了。”

王江河赶紧把手伸直，让盘子离自己远点儿。全家人落座，要不说有人就是记吃不记打呢，王铁柱大口的吃着肉饼。吐字不清的说道：“还是大儿子在家好......。”

后面的话还没说出口，在秦婉犀利的眼神下，生生的咽了下去。秦婉今天本来就气不顺，王铁柱还用话刺激她，这不是找不自在呢。王野笑嘻嘻的看着，手上也没停，一直在喂小丫头吃饭。

谁知道今天秦婉是无差别攻击呀，瞪着王野：“今后不许喂她吃饭了，都多大了！”

王野是不会在这个时候顶嘴的，可是小丫头初生牛犊不怕虎：“大锅喂，大锅好。”

这话算是把秦婉气到了，这个小丫头片子是要造反啦：“你以后再喂一下试试，你们兄妹俩都没饭吃。”

王野赶紧拦下还要张嘴的王笑笑，低头开始吃饭。在紧张的气氛中，很快就吃完了这顿饭，王野就跟着赵爷爷一起去了街道办，今天是周日，只有几个值班的人。

赵爷爷的证明很齐全，很顺利就办好了证明。如果只是简单整理一下，是不用开证明的，可是王野除了主体不动，其他的都要重弄，相对来说动静不算小。为了保险起见，王野还是需要开个证明的。

开完证明，王野就带着小丫头去了秦伟家。出门时，王野特意背了一个背篓，快到秦伟家时，才从空间里直接把食材放进背篓中。门卫很远就看见了这个背着背篓，抱着小姑娘的大男孩儿了，对于王野他们已经熟悉了。

王野上前要接受询问，谁知门卫先开口了：“小兄弟又来看首长了，这次背的东西不少呀？”

王野赶紧从兜里拿出一包中华，递给门卫：“大哥，我这儿占着手呢，劳驾你给兄弟们分分。”

两人又客气了几句，王野才进去，这次直奔秦伟家。在院子里，秦天韵正在哄着秦天悦玩儿，小姑娘看见王野抱着的王笑笑，高兴的不得了。王笑笑同样也很高兴，在王野怀里不停的扭动着。

Qin Wan saw the meat cakes on the pot table and stretched Wang Ye's ears: "Come on, show me, are these small meat cakes? One of them is as big as a washbasin."

"Mom, mother, mother~, it hurts, it hurts. It's not as big as a washbasin, it's obviously smaller than the washbasin."

Qin Wan let go of her hand, lifted the lid of the pot, and went to grab Wang Ye's ears again. This time, Wang Ye was well prepared and ran to the door in two steps: "You call this porridge? Just make the rice more soup. You're a prodigal, you can't live at all."

Wang Ye pointed to the noodle counter: "Mom, I went to Pigeon Market last night and got back a lot of rice and flour. It's enough for our family. Besides, it's okay to have a good meal once in a while."

Qin Wan quickly went to see the noodle cabinet. When she opened the door, she looked at the two full noodle pockets inside.He reached in and touched it, then rummaged through the cabinet.After searching for a while, he turned around and asked Wang Ye: "Where is the alternative food in our noodle cabinet?"

Wang Ye put in the rice and flour last night, but Qin Wan had to give a reply since he asked: "I took it to the pigeon market yesterday. Mom, it's better to eat less of that food. I heard that eating too much of alternative grains will lead to food accumulation."

How could Qin Wan not know that if she eats too much alternative food, she will accumulate food? In severe cases, she will not be able to defecate for several days.My eldest son changed the substitute grain into refined grain, so I can't blame him. Besides, this is not the first time that he has returned to refined grain.

Qin Wan sighed and went to serve the rice. He had already done it, so what else could he do.With the current weather, we can't leave it alone. It will be broken in just two days.Qin Wan shouted, and Wang Tiezhu and Wang Jianghe came to bring the bowls.

Wang Jianghe was carrying a large plate of meatloaf, smelling the aroma vigorously as he walked.Qin Wan's scolding voice came from behind: "If you dare to drool on the cake, you won't have to eat breakfast today."

Wang Jianghe quickly stretched his hands to keep the plate away from him.The whole family sat down, and some people just cared about eating rather than fighting. Wang Tiezhu ate the meat pie with big mouthfuls.He said with unclear enunciation: "It's better for the eldest son to be at home..."

Before the next words were spoken, Qin Wan swallowed them alive under Qin Wan's sharp eyes.Qin Wan was already upset today, and Wang Tiezhu used words to irritate her. This was not to make her feel uncomfortable.Wang Ye looked at it with a smile, and kept feeding the little girl without stopping.

Who knew that Qin Wan would attack indiscriminately today, glaring at Wang Ye: "Don't feed her from now on, she's so old!"

Wang Ye would not talk back at this time, but the little girl's newborn calf is not afraid of tigers: "Big pot, big pot is good."

These words made Qin Wan very angry. This little girl was about to rebel: "You can try feeding her again in the future. You two brothers and sisters will have nothing to eat."

Wang Ye quickly stopped Wang Xiaoxiao who was about to open his mouth, lowered his head and started eating.In a tense atmosphere, Wang Ye finished the meal quickly and followed Grandpa Zhao to the street office. Today was Sunday and there were only a few people on duty.

Grandpa Zhao’s certificate was very complete and the certificate was issued smoothly.If it was just a simple arrangement, there would be no need to issue a proof. However, Wang Ye had to redo everything except the main body, which was relatively small.To be on the safe side, Wang Ye still needs to issue a certificate.

After issuing the certificate, Wang Ye took the little girl to Qin Wei's house.When he went out, Wang Ye specially carried a basket on his back. When he was approaching Qin Wei's house, he put the ingredients directly into the basket from the space.The guard saw this big boy carrying a basket on his back and holding a little girl from a distance. They were already familiar with Wang Ye.

Wang Ye stepped forward to be questioned, but the guard spoke first: "My little brother came to see the leader again. Is he carrying a lot of things this time?"

Wang Ye quickly took out a packet of Chinese food from his pocket and handed it to the guard: "Brother, I have my hand here. Please share it with the brothers."

The two exchanged a few more polite words before Wang Ye went in, this time going straight to Qin Wei's house.In the yard, Qin Tianyun was coaxing Qin Tianyue to play. The little girl was very happy when she saw Wang Xiaoxiao in Wang Ye's arms.Wang Xiaoxiao was also very happy and kept squirming in Wang Ye's arms.
